title: Fire Back About Your New Babys Sex

drums.description: Hard rock drum solo and groove, Acoustic drum kit with a bright, resonant snare, deep kick drum, and shimmering cymbals, 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, The performance begins with a series of rapid-fire snare rolls and syncopated kick drum accents, transitioning into a heavy backbeat groove, The hi-hat remains tightly closed during the initial patterns before opening for accented barks, The ride cymbal is used for bell accents during the mid-section, Frequent use of double-kick flams and triplets across the rack and floor toms, High-velocity stick hits with minimal room reverb, emphasizing a dry, punchy studio sound Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, The track is built around a distorted, overdriven kick drum that provides a saturated low-end punch, A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes, processed with a short delay and high-pass filtering, A gritty, resonant bassline follows a syncopated pattern, interlocking with the kick, Industrial foley samples and mechanical clangs are layered throughout, treated with dark plate reverb, The tempo is 130 BPM in the key of D minor, Periodic white noise sweeps and distorted vocal fragments create rhythmic tension, The arrangement features sudden low-pass filter cuts and stutter effects on the master bus Publish
